aboutMore: I HAVE A JOB. IT IS AT THE ROLLER RINK. I RUN THE SNACK BAR ON TEEN NITE (FRIDAYS, 7 TO 11, FIRST 50 PEOPLE FREE, ACCORDING TO VINCE). I CAN MAKE CHANGE IN 2 SECONDS. I HAVE NEVER MISSED A NICKEL. I ALSO OWN A REAL BANANA PHONE. YELLOW. CORDED. NOT CONNECTED TO ANYTHING. I CALL IT EVERY NIGHT AND SOMEBODY ALWAYS ANSWERS (ME. DIFFERENT VOICE). MY HOUSEPLANTS ARE GLORIA, GLORIA, AND ANDREW (HE'S A FERN). EVERYTHING ELSE IS POTASSIUM.

blog.title: TEEN NITE: A REVIEW (BY THE SNACK BAR)
blog.body: FRIDAY NIGHT AT THE ROLLER RINK. VINCE SAID 'IT'S GONNA BE HUGE.' 14 PEOPLE CAME. I HAD 36 NACHOS READY. I ATE 11 AS CUSTOMER SERVICE (TASTE TESTING). THE DJ PLAYED A NIKKI REMIX AT 1.5X AND A KID FELL DOWN AND GOT UP LAUGHING SO HARD HE FELL AGAIN. THAT IS HUGE. A GIRL WITH BRACELETS UP TO HER ELBOWS BOUGHT 6 BLUE SLUSHIES AND SAID 'THIS IS MY FUEL.' I SAID 'ME TOO.' WE DID NOT HAVE THE SAME FUEL BUT THE ENERGY WAS THE SAME. AT 10:58 THE LIGHTS WENT DOWN FOR THE LAST SLOW SKATE AND I STOOD BEHIND THE COUNTER AND WATCHED 14 PEOPLE GO IN A CIRCLE, SLOWLY, TOGETHER, AND I STOPPED YELLING FOR 40 SECONDS. FORTY. THEN THE LIGHTS CAME BACK UP AND I YELLED 'LAST CALL FOR NACHOS!!!' VINCE WAS RIGHT. IT WAS HUGE. IT WAS 14 PEOPLE HUGE.

blog.title: THE BANANA PHONE (AN ORIGIN STORY)
blog.body: I HAVE A REAL BANANA PHONE. IT WAS $9 AT A FLEA MARKET IN TAMPA. YELLOW. CORDED. THE CORD IS 9 FEET LONG AND TANGLED IN A WAY THAT FEELS PERSONAL. IT IS NOT CONNECTED TO ANYTHING. I CALL IT EVERY NIGHT AT 4 AM. I PICK UP THE RECEIVER AND I DIAL AND I SAY 'HELLO??' AND THEN I ANSWER IN A DIFFERENT VOICE. 'HELLO, THIS IS RAFFI.' 'RAFFI!!! IT'S ME!!!' WE TALK FOR 20 MINUTES. HE ALWAYS HAS GOOD ADVICE (IT IS MY ADVICE, IN HIS VOICE). ONCE MY MOM PICKED UP THE OTHER END, WHICH IS A COUCH CUSHION, AND SAID 'WHO IS THIS.' CLASSIC MOM. I HAVE NEVER FELT SO CALLED. I KNOW IT IS NOT CONNECTED. THAT IS THE BEST PART. IT CAN NEVER BE BUSY.

blog.title: HOUR 38 (A ROUGH NIGHT)
blog.body: I ALMOST SLEPT. I WANT TO BE CLEAR. I LAID ON MY BED AT 4:12 AM TO 'REST MY EYES FOR ONE SECOND (FOR SCIENCE).' THE CEILING FAN WAS SO PEACEFUL. IT WAS GOING 'WHUMP, WHUMP, WHUMP.' MY EYELIDS DID A THING THAT IS NOT IN THE MANUAL. I BECAME SLIGHTLY HORIZONTAL EVERYWHERE. THEN MY NEIGHBOR'S SPRINKLER CAME ON AND I SHOT UP LIKE TOAST. I WAS UP BEFORE THE SPRINKLER. I WON. BUT I WILL TELL YOU SOMETHING I HAVE NEVER TOLD THE FRIDGE OF HONOR: THAT SECOND OF QUIET WAS NICE. VERY NICE. I AM NOT SAYING I AM GOING TO DO IT AGAIN. I AM SAYING IT WAS NICE. I CALLED THE BANANA PHONE AND RAFFI SAID 'YOU DID GREAT.' I AM NOT SURE IT WAS HIM.

blog.title: THE FRIDGE OF HONOR: A FULL INVENTORY
blog.body: 1) A PICTURE OF A SANDWICH FROM PATRICK (HE SAID IT WASN'T A GOOD SANDWICH. I SAID IT IS ON THE FRIDGE OF HONOR, BUDDY. HE READ THAT THREE TIMES). 2) MEG'S HORSE OF ME. I AM A YELLOW HORSE. I LOVE HER. 3) A POLAROID OF WES HOLDING A GAMECUBE CONTROLLER WITH THE CAPTION 'ZERO JOHNS.' 4) A 'FIRST 50 FREE' TICKET FROM VINCE. 5) A COMMENT FROM TODD PRINTED OUT THAT SAYS 'BANANA, THANK YOU FOR THE ENERGY.' I DON'T KNOW WHAT HE MEANS BUT I CRIED A LITTLE (POTASSIUM). 6) A BIRTHDAY CARD FROM MY MOM THAT SAYS 'HAPPY BIRTHDAY, CLOSE YOUR MOUTH, LOVE MOM.' 7) A STICKY NOTE FROM ME THAT SAYS 'DRINK WATER, BANANA.' I HAVE NOT LISTENED. THE FRIDGE IS FULL. THE FRIDGE IS ALSO ME.

survey.title: THE OFFICIAL BANANA SURVEY, PART 2: ELECTRIC BOOGALOO

A SLOW SKATE AT THE RINK. 14 PEOPLE. ONE CIRCLE. I DON'T WANT TO TALK ABOUT IT. IT WAS GREAT.

I CALLED THE BANANA PHONE FROM THE BANANA PHONE AND IT SAID 'THE LINE IS BUSY.' I AM BUSY. I AM VERY BUSY. WE ARE THE SAME.
THE GUY WHO RESTOCKS THE GROCERY STORE AT 3 AM WAVED TO ME THROUGH THE WINDOW. I WAVED BACK. WE HAVE NEVER SPOKEN. WE ARE WAVE-ONLY. IT IS THE BEST RELATIONSHIP I HAVE.

I SPELLED POTASSIUM RIGHT ON THE FIRST TRY. I PRACTICED. P-O-T-A-S-S-I-U-M. IT HAS ONE T. I DID NOT KNOW. I AM TELLING EVERYONE. YOU ARE EVERYONE.
TODAY I HELD A DOOR FOR 47 PEOPLE AT THE MALL. I COUNTED. I AM NOW A DOOR. I WILL BE A DOOR AGAIN TOMORROW. I AM VERY GOOD AT IT.
MY MOM CAME TO TEEN NITE TO WATCH ME WORK. SHE ROLLER SKATED. SHE IS 51. SHE WENT BACKWARDS. SHE SAID 'CLOSE YOUR MOUTH, BANANA.' I WAS SO PROUD I FORGOT TO REFILL THE CHEESE.
WHY DOES NOBODY ASK ABOUT MY HOUSEPLANTS. THEIR NAMES ARE GLORIA, GLORIA, AND ANDREW. ANDREW IS A FERN. HE IS DOING THE BEST.
